selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What picture of the world did the man first imagine before hearing the verse?
questions.answer: He imagined a world that felt lost, dark, temporary, and without clear purpose.

questions.question: What change happened when the verse was heard?
questions.answer: It made the world seem bright, meaningful, and full of life.

questions.question: How did the verse affect the way the universe was understood?
questions.answer: It showed the universe as a place that points to Allah and follows His order.

questions.question: What did the world become like in the man’s understanding after hearing the verse?
questions.answer: It became like one huge place of worship.

questions.question: Which parts of creation were described as praising Allah?
questions.answer: The heavens, the earth, and all created things were described as glorifying Him.

questions.question: How were the creatures shown after the verse gave them meaning?
questions.answer: They were shown as gladly doing the jobs Allah gave them.

questions.question: What does this story teach about the power of the Qur’an’s language?
questions.answer: It teaches that the Qur’an’s words can deeply change how people see the world.

questions.question: Why did the traveler better understand the Qur’an’s strong influence on people?
questions.answer: He saw how its powerful message could move hearts and change whole ways of thinking.

questions.question: What long-lasting result of the Qur’an is mentioned at the end of the passage?
questions.answer: Its honor and rule have continued without stopping for fourteen centuries.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest about why the Qur’an spread so widely?
questions.answer: Its beautiful and powerful message reached people’s hearts and minds.

questions.question: Why was the man told to imagine going back to the time when the Qur’an was first being revealed?
questions.answer: He was told to do that so he could understand the verse the way its first listeners might have felt it.

questions.question: What problem did the man have with the verse at first?
questions.answer: He thought it did not seem especially amazing in its wording.

questions.question: After imagining that earlier time, what did he begin to notice?
questions.answer: He began to notice how greatly the verse changed the meaning of the whole universe.

questions.question: What happened to the “veil” over the universe in the story?
questions.answer: It was lifted, so the universe seemed clear and full of truth.

questions.question: How did the verse help conscious beings, according to the passage?
questions.answer: It taught them and helped them understand creation in the right way.

questions.question: What comparison is used for the cosmos after the verse is heard?
questions.answer: It is compared to a giant mosque.

questions.question: In that comparison, what were created things doing?
questions.answer: They were remembering Allah and declaring His greatness.

questions.question: What feeling did the created world seem to have while doing its duty?
questions.answer: It seemed joyful and pleased.

questions.question: What did the traveler learn by comparing this verse with other verses in a similar way?
questions.answer: He learned one reason the Qur’an has had such great success and influence.

questions.question: What two big results of the Qur’an are named in the final sentence of the target passage?
questions.answer: Its reaching a large part of the world and many people, and its lasting greatness for fourteen centuries.

questions.question: At the beginning of the passage, what did the man say he could not recognize in the verse?
questions.answer: He said he could not recognize its amazing beauty and power in language.

questions.question: What method was used to help him understand the verse better?
questions.answer: He was asked to imagine hearing it in the earlier time before the Qur’an changed people’s view of the world.

questions.question: Before hearing the verse, how did the universe appear to him?
questions.answer: It appeared confused, dark, temporary, and almost empty of meaning.

questions.question: After hearing the verse, what happened to his understanding of the earth?
questions.answer: He saw the earth as brightened and given a clearer meaning.
